svg.title: Carboxylic acid conversion to acyl chloride: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Chlorosulfite-derived leaving group → SO2 + Cl−. Fragmentation of the leaving group supplies SO2 and chloride; counterion/proton inventory is stated in the net equation.

g.text: Carboxylic acid conversion to acyl chloride · 5
